result.title: Learning Holistic Scene Layout against View Shifts in Cross-View Geo-Localization
result.summary: Cross-view geo-localization remains challenging due to drastic appearance variations and geometric distortions caused by viewpoint changes. Existing methods primarily rely on discriminative feature learning or explicit geometric alignment, yet often overlook an important observation: humans tend to match scenes by integrating the spatial context of multiple landmarks rather than relying solely on isolated local visual cues. Inspired by this, we propose a Spatial Context Modeling (SCM) module, which traverses feature maps along four orthogonal directions and models interactions among the resulting directional representations at each spatial position. By aggregating complementary directional observations, SCM constructs richer scene layout representations. Since reliable spatial context depends on robust visual features, we introduce a High-Frequency Information Guidance (HFIG) module that extracts stable structural cues from the frequency domain. By emphasizing edges and contours that are less sensitive to appearance variations, HFIG encourages the model to learn more robust representations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves competitive performance on standard cross-view geo-localization benchmarks while exhibiting strong robustness under more challenging scenarios with unknown orientations and limited fields of view (FoVs).

AI.brief_summary: 论文针对跨视角地理定位中视角变化带来的外观差异与几何畸变，提出 Spatial Context Modeling 模块，沿四个正交方向遍历特征图并在每个空间位置建模方向性表示间的交互，以聚合互补方向信息构建整体场景布局；同时用 High-Frequency Information Guidance 从频域提取对视角不敏感的边缘与轮廓结构线索。
AI.relevance_reason: 四方向扫描式的特征遍历与方向上下文聚合，可能为 LVR 中视觉 latent 状态的更新方式与结构信息保留提供可核查的方法线索；高频结构引导亦可供考察哪些视觉细节应在内部状态中抵抗外观变化，但该文面向检索式匹配任务，未涉及推理状态生成或答案对 latent 的使用。
